from __future__ import annotations

import io
import json
from time import perf_counter

from django.core.management import call_command
from django.db import connection, transaction
from django.utils import timezone

from core.integration.system_audit_runtime_config import load_system_audit_runtime_config

started = perf_counter()
output = io.StringIO()
with transaction.atomic():
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY")
        cursor.execute("SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '180s'")
        cursor.execute("SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'")
    runtime = load_system_audit_runtime_config(environment="production")
    call_command("repair_active_a_share_current_facts", stdout=output)
    payload = json.loads(output.getvalue())
    result = {
        "operation": "DATA-02 current candidate dry-run",
        "read_mode": "REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY",
        "observed_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
        "elapsed_seconds": perf_counter() - started,
        "runtime": {
            "mode": runtime.mode,
            "outbox_enabled": runtime.outbox_enabled,
            "selector_is_none": runtime.authority_selector is None,
            "snapshot_id": runtime.snapshot_id,
            "snapshot_hash": runtime.snapshot_hash,
        },
        "preview": payload,
    }
print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from time import perf_counter

from django.db import connection, transaction
from django.db.models import Count, F, OuterRef, Subquery
from django.utils import timezone

from apps.data_center.application.query_services import list_active_stock_codes_for_backfill
from apps.data_center.application.query_use_cases import latest_completed_cn_market_session
from apps.data_center.composition import make_core_current_fact_refresh_use_case
from apps.data_center.infrastructure.valuation_fact_repository import ValuationFactModel
from core.integration.system_audit_runtime_config import load_system_audit_runtime_config

started = perf_counter()
with transaction.atomic():
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY")
        cursor.execute("SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '180s'")
        cursor.execute("SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'")
    observed_at = timezone.now()
    codes = tuple(list_active_stock_codes_for_backfill())
    session = latest_completed_cn_market_session(observed_at)
    coordinator = make_core_current_fact_refresh_use_case(source_type="akshare", created_by="ops.current_fact_refresh.preview")
    runtime = load_system_audit_runtime_config(environment="production")
    datasets = []
    for rebuilder in coordinator._publications._rebuilders:
        try:
            value = rebuilder.preview(asset_codes=codes, published_at=observed_at).to_dict()
            datasets.append({"dataset_key": rebuilder.dataset.dataset_key, "result": value, "error": None})
        except ValueError as error:
            datasets.append({"dataset_key": rebuilder.dataset.dataset_key, "result": None, "error": str(error)})
    latest_row = ValuationFactModel._default_manager.filter(asset_code=OuterRef("asset_code")).order_by(F("val_date").desc(), F("observed_at").desc(nulls_last=True), F("available_at").desc(nulls_last=True), F("fetched_at").desc(), F("revision_number").desc(), F("id").desc()).values("id")[:1]
    selected = ValuationFactModel._default_manager.filter(asset_code__in=codes, pk=Subquery(latest_row))
    invalid = selected.filter(observed_at__isnull=True)
    result = {
        "operation": "DATA-02 per-dataset gaps after strict preview failure",
        "read_mode": "REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY",
        "observed_at": observed_at.isoformat(),
        "elapsed_seconds": perf_counter() - started,
        "asset_count": len(codes),
        "session_date": session.isoformat() if session else None,
        "runtime": {"mode": runtime.mode, "outbox_enabled": runtime.outbox_enabled, "selector_is_none": runtime.authority_selector is None, "snapshot_id": runtime.snapshot_id, "snapshot_hash": runtime.snapshot_hash},
        "financial_availability": coordinator._financial_availability.preview(asset_codes=codes, recorded_at=observed_at).to_dict(),
        "completed_session_prices": coordinator._completed_session_prices.preview(asset_codes=codes, session_date=session, recorded_at=observed_at).to_dict(),
        "publication_datasets": datasets,
        "valuation_latest_rows": selected.count(),
        "valuation_latest_missing_observed_at": invalid.count(),
        "valuation_missing_observed_at_groups": list(invalid.values("source", "val_date").annotate(rows=Count("pk")).order_by("source", "val_date")),
        "valuation_missing_observed_at_sample": list(invalid.order_by("asset_code").values("id", "asset_code", "val_date", "source", "observed_at", "available_at", "fetched_at", "source_record_id", "raw_payload_hash")[:10]),
        "claim": "diagnostic only; strict publication rejection is preserved and no observed_at repair or publication mutation was performed",
    }
print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, default=str), flush=True)

from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
import hashlib
import json
from collections import Counter
from time import perf_counter

from django.db import connection, transaction
from django.utils import timezone

from apps.data_center.application.query_services import list_active_stock_codes_for_backfill
from apps.data_center.application.query_use_cases import latest_completed_cn_market_session
from apps.data_center.composition import make_core_current_fact_refresh_use_case

started = perf_counter()
with transaction.atomic():
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY")
        cursor.execute("SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '180s'")
        cursor.execute("SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'")
    observed_at = timezone.now()
    universe = tuple(list_active_stock_codes_for_backfill())
    assert len(universe) == 5533 and len(set(universe)) == len(universe)
    codes = list(universe[:200])
    session = latest_completed_cn_market_session(observed_at)
    coordinator = make_core_current_fact_refresh_use_case(source_type="akshare", created_by="ops.current_fact_refresh.preview")
    sync = coordinator._valuation_sync_factory()
    config, provider = sync._get_provider(coordinator._provider_id)
    quotes = provider.fetch_quote_snapshots(codes)
    valuations = provider.fetch_current_valuations(codes, session)
    quote_values = [dataclasses.asdict(value) for value in quotes]
    valuation_values = [dataclasses.asdict(value) for value in valuations]
    def seal(values):
        serialized = json.dumps(values, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, default=str, separators=(",", ":"))
        return hashlib.sha256(serialized.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    payload = {
        "operation": "DATA-02 200-asset configured-provider bounded source preflight",
        "read_mode": "database REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY; public external provider GET calls",
        "started_at": observed_at.isoformat(),
        "completed_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
        "elapsed_seconds": perf_counter() - started,
        "universe_count": len(universe),
        "universe_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(universe, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest(),
        "provider_id": coordinator._provider_id,
        "provider_name": provider.provider_name(),
        "batch_offset": 0,
        "asset_codes": codes,
        "session_date": session.isoformat(),
        "quote_count": len(quotes),
        "quote_exact_coverage": len(quotes) == len(codes) and {value.asset_code for value in quotes} == set(codes),
        "quote_source_dates": dict(Counter(value.snapshot_at.date().isoformat() for value in quotes)),
        "valuation_count": len(valuations),
        "valuation_exact_coverage": len(valuations) == len(codes) and {value.asset_code for value in valuations} == set(codes),
        "valuation_source_dates": dict(Counter(value.observed_at.date().isoformat() if value.observed_at else "missing" for value in valuations)),
        "quote_adapter_values_sha256": seal(quote_values),
        "valuation_adapter_values_sha256": seal(valuation_values),
        "quote_adapter_values": quote_values,
        "valuation_adapter_values": valuation_values,
        "limitations": ["Adapter-value hashes are not raw vendor-payload hashes or Publication identities.", "A historical weekend observation is not realtime quote freshness.", "No sync execute, fact upsert, audit runtime activation or Publication switch occurred."],
    }
print(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, default=str), flush=True)

Financial candidate selection covers all assets, but that does not prove financial report-date/lineage correctness. The null-available-at repair preview presently has no eligible rows; avoid a blind repair pass.
No external provider call, runtime activation, fact repair, Publication switch or acceptance-state change was performed by these REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY diagnostics.
The per-dataset diagnostic elapsed_seconds field was captured before final financial/price preview and valuation-count result construction, so it is not the full probe latency.
The configured provider produced exact quote/valuation coverage of the first 200 frozen-universe assets with source dates 2026-09-11. The hashes seal adapter values, not vendor raw response bytes.

Capture actual response receipt as conservative first-known availability before a fact repair batch; do not backdate availability to historical observed_at or substitute a fetch clock for observed_at. This is a separate bounded implementation prerequisite after EVID-08.
